objective: Improve Assistant outcome quality and complete-task reliability with concise general instructions; prompt length and workflow cost are guardrails, not optimization targets. Avoid case-specific examples and cumulative patches.

integrationGate.interpretation: Native HomeRouter/resource integration validates transfer boundaries; it need not demonstrate a separate gain on its six authored families. No real browser/service execution claim.

guardrails.measurement: Provider input/cache/output/reasoning, requests/tool rounds and elapsed time; paired-family total-token intervals also published. Instruction growth is measured baseline/candidate provider-input difference under an explicit identical control, not an undocumented tokenizer claim.

stop: Final personal-first ordering candidate after one failed added-restriction candidate. No further semantic tuning. Use exposed development, then fresh frozen replay/native families only if development supports it. Retain baseline when gates fail; no result-driven edits or case replacements.
review: Blinded Luna High grade, eight frozen author-gold calibration controls, independent whole-family source/grade audits with originals preserved; not independent human validation.
preConfirmationDesignCorrection: The first quality candidate added a requested-project condition that source review flagged as potentially rejecting implicit current-project context; development exposed that regression. Its run and frozen policy are preserved. Final candidate restores the original project semantics and isolates personal-first ordering, without new conditions/examples. Quality thresholds and fresh cases are unchanged.
